name: Carla F. Stern
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Atlanta, Georgia

firm.name: Stern Edlin Graham Family Law, P.C.

about: With over three decades of experience in the legal profession, Carla F. Stern has focused her practice on family law. Practicing at Stern Edlin Graham Family Law, P.C., in Atlanta, Georgia, she handles matters involving custody, divorce, alimony, child support, spousal support, adoption and property disputes. As a National Board of Trial Advocacy-certified family law attorney, she holds a track record of successfully handling complex marriage dissolution and child custody cases.

With her strong advocacy, mediation and litigation skills, Ms. Stern has counseled numerous high net worth clients. Her approach to each case is based on the fact that each client has their own unique needs and they need to be addressed in relation to each of them. Committed to connecting and fostering a relationship with her clients, she provides them with customized, innovative solutions to challenging issues.

Upon graduating from Miami University with a bachelor’s degree in business, Ms. Stern went on to pursue her legal studies at Quinnipiac University School of Law. Earning her Juris Doctor in 1990, she was admitted to the State Bar of Georgia in the following year. Dedicated to providing ethical and accessible legal counsel, she ensures her clients receive the highest level of representation and support throughout their legal journey. She believes in empowering her clients with knowledge and understanding, enabling them to make informed decisions that align with their goals and values.

Staying active in the legal community, Ms. Stern holds memberships with the Georgia Chapter of the American Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, the International Academy of Matrimonial Lawyers, the American Bar Association Family Law Section and the Atlanta Bar Association Family Law and Women in the Profession sections. Through her undying commitment and professionalism, she received an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer-review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Ratings™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
